description: Product Requirements Document for the School Nexus web frontend.

dashboard.description: Landing page after login showing quick overview of key metrics.

attendanceTracking.description: Record and view daily attendance for classes.

financeFeeManagement.description: Handle fee structures, payments, and financial reports.

layoutGuidelines.typography: Tailwind defaults with custom font family

uiUx.responsiveness: Mobile‑first, breakpoints at sm (640px), md (768px), lg (1024px)

stateManagement.strategy: React Context for global UI state + Redux Toolkit for domain data
stateManagement.dataFetching: RTK Query with auto‑generated hooks, caching, and optimistic updates
stateManagement.sideEffects: createAsyncThunk for async actions, middleware for logging and error handling

apiIntegration.auth: Bearer token from login endpoint, stored in HttpOnly cookie
apiIntegration.errorHandling: Standardized error shape {code, message, details}, mapped to UI toast notifications
apiIntegration.rateLimiting: Client respects X‑Rate‑Limit headers, exponential backoff on 429

testing.integration: React Testing Library with mock Service Worker for API contracts
testing.e2e: Playwright scripts covering critical user flows
